raw.details:
Overview:

DevHack 2026 is a 36-hour offline hackathon organized by the Sahyadri Open Source Community (SOSC) as part of DevHost 2026.

The competition begins with an online ideation round, followed by a final 36-hour offline hackathon at Sahyadri Campus, Mangaluru.

IMPORTANT: ROUND 1 IS COMPLETELY FREE

No payment is required to register or participate in Round 1.
The ₹250 participation fee is applicable only to teams shortlisted for the final offline hackathon and will be collected after the Round 1 results during the final-round participation confirmation process.

Eligibility:

  • Open to all technical undergraduate degree college students.
  • Participants can be from any year of study.
  • All members of a team must belong to the same institute.
  • Each team can have a maximum of 4 members.
  • A participant can be part of only one team.
  • If shortlisted for the final round, all registered team members must attend the offline hackathon.

Format:

  • Format: Software Hackathon
  • Hardware: The hackathon is strictly software-based; hardware-based solutions are not required.

Registration & Round 1:

Registrations Open: 22 September 2026
Registration & PPT Submission Deadline: 22 October 2026

  • Round 1 registration is completely free. No payment is required to register or participate in the online ideation round.
  • Teams must register on Unstop and submit a PPT along with a drive link containing a demo video explaining and presenting their proposed solution.
  • The ₹250 participation fee is NOT required for round 1.
  • Only teams shortlisted for the final offline round will be required to pay the ₹250 participation fee. The fee will be applicable after Round 1 shortlisting and will be collected during the final-round participation confirmation/RSVP process.

PPT Requirements:

  • Team Name & Members
  • Team Leader’s Email, Phone No. & College Name
  • Problem Statement
  • Solution Summary
  • Technical Approach and Flow Diagrams
  • Impact and Benefits
  • Business Impact
  • Market Potential & Scalability
  • GitHub Link of MVP, Demo Video of MVP & Deployment Link (optional)

Round 1 Results: 4 November 2026

Shortlisted teams will receive further instructions to confirm their participation in the final offline round through RSVP. The ₹250 participation fee will be applicable at this stage.

Problem Statements & Rulebook:

The complete DevHack 2026 Rulebook is attached below and contains:

  • Complete hackathon details and guidelines
  • Round 1 submission requirements
  • Final-round rules and schedule
  • All problem statements across the four themes
  • Judging and participation guidelines

Participants are advised to go through the Rulebook before preparing their submission.

Final Round:

Venue: Sahyadri College Of Engineering & Management, Mangaluru

Hackathon Reporting: 12 November 2026, 10:00 AM
Hackathon Starts: 12 November 2026, 11:00 AM
Final Event Ends: 14 November 2026, 2:30 AM

All shortlisted teams must be present at the venue on time and complete the mandatory reporting and offline team verification process. Teams will then have 36 hours of dedicated project development time, with mentor checkpoints, meals, and engaging activities scheduled throughout the event to support and enhance their experience.

Prizes:

  • 1st Prize: ₹50,000
  • 2nd Prize: ₹30,000
  • 3rd Prize: ₹20,000

Participant Benefits:

For Top 30 Shortlisted Teams

  • n8n: Cloud Pro license and full access during the hackathon.
  • Render: $50 credits for hackathon attendees.
  • Sarvar AI: 500 AI credits for every participating hackathon team.
  • .xyz: One-year domain for every participating hackathon team .

For Winning Teams

1st Prize Team

  • ₹50,000 cash prize
  • Render: $500 credits
  • CodeCrafters: 2-year VIP membership

2nd Prize Team

  • ₹30,000 cash prize
  • Render: $300 credits
  • CodeCrafters: 1-year VIP membership

3rd Prize Team

  • ₹20,000 cash prize
  • Render: $100 credits
  • CodeCrafters: 6-month VIP membership

Incubation Opportunity

5–10 selected hackathon teams will have the opportunity to receive free incubation support from ACIC Sahyadri Foundation.

Rules:

  • All solutions must be original.
  • Plagiarism or reuse of previously completed projects is strictly prohibited.
  • Teams may not collaborate with or seek assistance from other competing teams.
  • The submitted solution must directly address the selected problem statement.
  • Teams must follow all instructions, guidelines, and deadlines specified by the organizers.
  • The organizers reserve the right to make necessary changes to the event schedule, rules, guidelines, or other arrangements at any time. Any such updates or last-minute changes communicated by the organizers must be followed by all participating teams.
  • Teams are expected to remain flexible and comply with any instructions or modifications announced during the event.
  • Judges’ decisions will be final and binding.

Note: The problem statements and other instructions are provided in the DevHack 2026 Rulebook attached below.

Join DevHack 2026 and turn your idea into a working solution.
